title: Third End superboss slot reserved and unassigned
description:
Tyros and Scylla are optional superboss challenges. After a Tier 8 milestone and both victories, hold one affixed equipment item below Heirloom and use /ao_mastery upgrade. This changes the held item once; it does not give a second item.

Third End superboss slot reserved and unassigned.

This reserved encounter has no selected boss and does not block the final mastery upgrade.
